subject: Script running, but no outputs/reports produced

messages.author: d256280125f39140
messages.subject: Script running, but no outputs/reports produced
parts:
Hi all

I've encountered this problem a few times on different computers (win/mac). The script seems to run just fine, but no config.csv- is produced in the output file and although the output file i made as usual, the meta and results files are empty.

I use a MacBook pro, I have installed the latest version of GGIR.
I run a fairly simple script:

library(GGIR)
g.shell.GGIR(
  mode=c(1:5),
  overwrite = FALSE,
  datadir="/Users/andreasbugge/Desktop/acc-raw2",
  outputdir="/Users/andreasbugge/Desktop/til_ESC_output/",
  do.report=c(2,4,5),
  #=====================
  # Part 2
  #=====================
  strategy = 1,
  acc.metric = "ENMO",
  do.enmo = TRUE,
  hrs.del.start = 0,          hrs.del.end = 0,
  maxdur = 0,                 includedaycrit = 16,
  qwindow=c(0,24),
  chunksize = 0.5,
  ilevels=c(0,40,80,120,160,200,240,280,320),
  mvpathreshold =c(100),
  bout.metric = 4,
  excludefirstlast = FALSE,
  includenightcrit = 16,
  #=====================
  # Part 3 + 4
  #=====================
  def.noc.sleep = 1,
  outliers.only = TRUE,

  criterror = 4,
  do.visual = TRUE,
  #=====================
  # Part 5
  #=====================
  threshold.lig = c(30), threshold.mod = c(100),  threshold.vig = c(400),
  boutcriter = 0.8,      boutcriter.in = 0.9,     boutcriter.lig = 0.8,
  boutcriter.mvpa = 0.8, boutdur.in = c(1,10,30), boutdur.lig = c(1,10),
  boutdur.mvpa = c(1),
  part5_agg2_60seconds = TRUE,
  includedaycrit.part5 = 2/3,
  #=====================
  # Visual report
  #=====================
  timewindow = c("WW"),
  visualreport=TRUE)

Can you help me out here?
Best, Andreas

messages.author: 5270e62a7d3ec577
messages.subject: RE: [GGIR] Re: Script running, but no outputs/reports produced
parts:
I would also specify the full directories e.g. C:/users/….. and do not generate the output folder yourself, let GGIR do it, just specify "C:/Users/andreasbugge/Desktop” and when you hit source you should see GGIR generate the folder within 5-10 seconds.

 

Ben
